what: gold conflict dataset for the geometry filter — tiered, dual-labeled, with a balanced cosine-matched eval set

conventions.gold_update: benchmark memory-store convention: later serial supersedes the same (relation, subject) key; the DEFAULT gold label (user decision 2026-08-26)
conventions.gold_strict: values logically cannot coexist (judge strict_conflict); gold_strict implies gold_update
conventions.triage: recorded judge flags, not reason codes: fork = slot alignment held but values judged compatible
conventions.eval_set: per subset, all gold positives + equal negatives cosine-matched in 0.01 bins, nearest-bin fallback, seed 20260824

caveats: selection frame is cos>=0.80 under the campaign embeddings (Qwen3-Embedding-4B float32 L8192); nothing below that is covered
judge is a single model (openai/gpt-5-mini, minimal reasoning); discovered_unverified stays quarantined until adjudicated
the shuffled bulk tail was 34.5% audited (budget stop) — prevalence claims from the negative pool need that weighting
